I had a very different experience with this clinic. While in the treatment room, the dentist directly told me that my time was up. I understand that I arrived a little late (about 5–10 minutes), but the registration process also took extra time. By the time I finally saw the dentist, he seemed unfriendly—not that it bothered me much. What really did bother me was when he bluntly said, "Time is up."

Considering I paid almost 5,000 THB just for a cleaning, I expected better treatment. The cleaning itself was done extremely quickly—around 15–20 minutes, if I recall correctly. While the dentist may be skilled, my past experiences with dental cleanings have always taken longer. This felt rushed and not worth the price I paid. I didn’t even have time to ask any questions.

I won’t be returning to this clinic. Instead, I’ll go back to Bangkok Hospital Dental Center, where the dentists take their time and provide better care. Based on the service I received and the way the dentist spoke to me from the start, I would have rated this clinic one star. However, I’m giving two stars because the other staff members were friendly and polite, despite the delays in registration.
